subject: humanities
notes: Cologne Cathedral is a Gothic cathedral in Cologne, Germany.
Construction of the cathedral began in 1248.
Work stopped in the 1470s and did not resume for more than 350 years.
The cathedral was finally completed in 1880.
When it was completed, its twin spires made it the tallest building in the world.
stem: The student wants to emphasize how long it took to complete Cologne Cathedral. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Work on Cologne Cathedral stopped in the 1470s and did not resume for more than 350 years.
choices.B: When Cologne Cathedral was completed in 1880, its twin spires made it the tallest building in the world.
choices.C: Begun in 1248 but not finished until 1880, Cologne Cathedral took more than six centuries to complete.
choices.D: Cologne Cathedral, a Gothic cathedral in Germany, is a building whose construction began in 1248.

explanation.why: To show how long the whole project took, the sentence needs both the start date (1248) and the completion date (1880). Only one choice gives both and states the total of more than six centuries.
explanation.A: Incorrect. This shows a long pause, but not how long the whole project took from start to finish.
explanation.B: Incorrect. This gives the completion date and a fact about height, but it leaves out when construction began.
explanation.C: Correct. It gives the start and finish dates and the total time, more than six centuries.
explanation.D: Incorrect. This gives only the start date, so the reader cannot tell how long construction lasted.
